changelog: Affiliate payments: a payment entered as transactions × unit price shows its breakdown under the commission base in the admin payment list and on the partner portal's commissions page (#3554).

en: A payment entered as transactions × price now shows that breakdown under the amount, for admins and for the partner.
tr: İşlem sayısı × fiyat olarak girilen bir ödemenin dökümü artık tutarın altında görünüyor; hem admin hem partner için.
de: Eine als Transaktionen × Preis erfasste Zahlung zeigt diese Aufschlüsselung jetzt unter dem Betrag – für Admins und für den Partner.
